hero.eyebrow: Next-gen for all your social media accounts
hero.sub: Don't let your visitors see a static page when they click your link — let them talk to an agent that knows your business. Setup takes 10 minutes, no code required.
hero.note: No credit card required · Live in 10 minutes

statement.text: Don't you think "Link in bio" is getting old? Don't trap your customers in mazes with the old web-form layout. Leave your business to talkinbio; let it ask, guide, and answer.

steps.title: The setup itself is your agent's training.
steps.sub: No separate "train the AI" step. Every answer you give while setting up your page becomes your agent's knowledge base.

step1.title: Answer a few questions
step1.desc: What do you sell, what are your prices, your hours — you explain it in a simple chat flow, no form filling.

step2.title: Your page and your agent are born together
step2.desc: The information you provide turns into both a visible page and what your agent knows — one source, two outputs.

step3.title: Put your link in your bio, let it talk
step3.desc: Visitor asks a question, your agent answers, and takes note of interested customers for you.

features.title: Everything you need to grow your business, on one page.
features.sub: Not a complex panel — just exactly what you need for your business.

feat1.title: 24/7 talking agent
feat1.desc: Your customers can ask questions even while you sleep, your agent answers by knowing your business.

feat2.title: Photo and video
feat2.desc: Explain your services with visuals — add your own photo or short video to each block.

feat3.title: Multi-language support
feat3.desc: Your agent answers in whichever language the visitor writes, you only set it up in one language.

feat4.title: Your inbox is ready
feat4.desc: The name, contact, and request of every interested visitor automatically drops to you.

feat5.title: Don't bother with design
feat5.desc: You don't choose a theme, template, or layout — your page is automatically built from its content.

feat6.title: Ready for all social media
feat6.desc: One link, in one place — Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok. Suitable for all platforms.

audience.title: For everyone who uses social media professionally.
audience.sub: For those who struggle to answer appointments, pricing, availability questions and more one by one every day.
